column3: “Micah” renders the Hebrew “Micaiah” here and in verse 4.
NASB supplies “pieces of”; “in my hearing” renders “in my ears.”
“wholly dedicate” renders the doubled verb; “them” renders “it.”
“a shrine” renders “a house of God (gods)”; “household idols” renders “teraphim,” and “consecrated” renders “filled the hand of.”
“in his own eyes” renders “in his eyes.”
“a year” renders “for the days”; “went in” renders “went.”
